notes.title: Metro Awakening is coming November 7 - Pre-order NOW
notes.content:

[previewyoutube=YH2LUgJQze0;full][/previewyoutube]
Explore the awakening of a legend

This standalone prequel to Metro 2033 follows Serdar, a doctor braving the treacherous tunnels in search of his missing wife. As his sanity is pushed to the limit, Serdar confronts the edge between life and death, ultimately awakening as Khan, the legendary mystic figure whose wisdom and understanding of the tunnels' supernatural forces will echo through time, becoming the spiritual guide shaping the fate of those who dwell in the Metro depths.

notes.title: Welcome Back: Arizona Sunshine Remake is releasing on October 17. Pre-order now!

[previewyoutube=Svid78o9GJ4;full][/previewyoutube]
Arizona Sunshine® Remake elevates the original, award-winning game, completely rebuilt with GORE-geous VR graphics and next-gen VR combat and weapons. Face the undead alone or up to three fellow survivors in a post-apocalyptic southwestern America overrun by zombies, and experience a zombie-infested Arizona like never before:

 Gore-geous graphics: Immerse yourself in stunning new visuals, including high-resolution textures and realistic environmental details.

notes.title: Patch notes: Get a grip!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we have some additional updates and fixes for Arizona Sunshine. These address the issues of equipment dropping and weapon gripping. Here are the patch notes for version 1.9.21017.


 The "Can drop equipment" setting is now disabled by default, even when Valve Index controllers are connected.
 Fixed equipment not being saved, between level loads and at checkpoints, when "Can drop equipment" was enabled.
 Fixed a bug where items would unequip from a hand right after loading a level if the player held an item in that hand in the previous level.
 Fixed a bug where hands could no longer equip items after they unequipped a mounted item by outranging it.
 Fixed not being able to pick up items after throwing them and then picking them up before they've come to a complete stop.
 The 'Can drop equipment' grip tutorials now show on both hands when they're both holding items.
 The flashlight is now a headlight in two-handed mode when 'Can drop equipment' is enabled.


Other updates

 Fixed the calibration text being clipped on some languages.
 Fixed Oculus Rift S controllers not allowing you to change rotation mode.
 Fixed the last voice over line in the Sunshine level always playing in the English language.


Please update Arizona Sunshine to the latest version (1.9.21017) for these changes to be added. You can always leave your feedback here in the Steam forums, or on our official Discord Channel. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Traffic Jams brings traffic chaos to Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and Major PC VR Platforms in September!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a4b36c921eaa97ea91b0f2fe86cea83fbf533e31.jpg

Get your first hands-on with the first level of Traffic Jams in the demo on Steam!

In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. You start off in the quiet town of Gouda, but as you progress, traffic control job offers soon start pouring in from iconic cities around the globe. 

Rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite will be yours to control before road rage strikes. Yes, you read that right; meteorites! But those aren’t the only hazards; This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams/

During the UploadVR Summer Showcase, we've announced couch party mode! Share the fun of VR with up to four friends (read: frenemies), locally, on mobile devices! Have a look at the multiplayer trailer featuring none other than VR content creators Cas & Chary!


Meet Dennis, your instructor.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/935f8e316a856f68af08343962adf863670f55b1.jpg

Dennis is your greatest frenemy, your rival, but most importantly, for better or for worse, your teacher. Hailing from Jam City, the self-proclaimed "best traffic controller...EVER", takes you under his wing. His experience comes from the many flash mobs and packed intersections that his hometown is known for. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling.

If you give him a chance, (and the occasional dance), he'll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

This is only the first glimpse of the cities you’ll be handling in Traffic Jams, as there will be many different challenges, each with their own crazy events to face on this worldwide trip! We hope to see you on the crossroads for the full release; Traffic Jams will be available for Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and all major PC VR platforms in September 2020.

For more news about Traffic Jams, find us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram to stay up to date on all things Traffic Jams, and sign up for the newsletter at trafficjams-vr.com

notes.title: Two-Handed Update lumbering towards PC
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/d77525c5af974a8f6e0d44261ede94c71aa86a78.jpg

Hey all, another batch of free downloadable content is coming soon to your favorite VR zombie shooter, and with it support for various peripherals including the PP Gun and Omni, as well as a complete networking overhaul!

Read on to get the lowdown…

Two-handed mode
We are excited to announce we have partnered with the folks over at Shenzhen Simeng Technology to support the PP Gun, their two-handed gun-shaped VR controller for HTC Vive. With it, we will finally be able to bring two-handed mode to PC!

Originally developed with the PS VR Aim Controller (Sony’s two-handed VR gun) in mind, two-handed mode has you survive with 13 new two-handed weapons. Arizona Sunshine is all about shooting, so we wanted to provide the best experience when it comes to two-handed weapon support – with the PP Gun, we were able to get it exactly right. Of course, we realize not everyone will have a PP Gun at their disposal, nor play on HTC Vive. Therefore, two-handed mode will also be playable with regular motion controllers on both Oculus and HTC Vive – just be aware that it was designed with a two-handed gun peripheral in mind.
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/271c39ac320283f80aadfbe0a4d253bb6c6e21d9.jpg

Omni support
Giving new meaning to walking dead, Omni support is expected to arrive with the next big update as well.

Networking overhaul
In the mean time, we are also working on a huge overhaul of the matchmaking system on PC. With our latest VR game, Skyworld, we invested in a custom-built cross-platform matchmaking back-end built from the ground up, which we always intended to bring over to Arizona Sunshine once finalized. This new system will allow you to directly match and play with users from the leading PC store platforms, including Steam and Oculus. We also expect this will make network connections between players more robust. 

At the moment, we cannot comment on an ETA for the update other than 'soon' yet as we do not want to set expectations that we are not 100% sure we can meet. Such is the nature of game development! Stay tuned or subscribe to the newsletter to be the first to get updates.

notes.title: New Horde Mode Map Live - The Old Mine
notes.content:
We are pleased to add a new free multiplayer map to the game, the Old Mine.

No longer confined to a set play area, you can now roam the map. Search out ammo, weapons, and health regen as you put together the right combination of resources to survive. The map rewards enterprising players and teams that move around. Resources no longer spawn in a set area, but are found throughout the map. Powerful weapons don't give you the ability to camp as the ammo spawns elsewhere. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/6e752863e5aafa6e0d88796af5e94686bf91afae.jpg

Light is now a resource to be managed. How do you deploy flashlights and safety helmets? Can you get to that generator and back alive? Stairs, platforms, and ladders open new strategies for cover and movement, but be on your guard, Fred may have found some new ways to get to you too.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/c3f858096c45b34e6813f9ab1f760ab6da9ac762.jpg

Other Updates:

Tweaked locomotion speeds and stamina
Added a new hat: Safety helmet with light (only on the Old Mine Horde Mode map)
Added mirrored locomotion (aka left handed locomotion)
Fixed a bug which prevented the unlocking of achievements that count a certain number of actions
Flashlight: you may now change the position of the flashlight using the secondary action button (same as ejecting clips)


We are continuing work on multiplayer content like the previously reported, Undead Valley. After debuting a demo of this map at CES this year, we decided that we needed to do more work balancing the map.

notes.content:
Hi all,

We are happy to present you with the latest patch. We have tried to address all the issues that have been reported since launch. notes.title: VR shooter Arizona Sunshine has features locked behind timed CPU exclusivity [update: not any more]
notes.content:
Update: Following widespread condemnation of Arizona Sunshine's timed exclusive content, the studio has announced that it's rolling back the limitations. In other words, there's no longer any exclusivity at all.Here's the full statement:Thank you for all your feedback on the game. We developed the game to be as immersive and engaging as we could. While we love to hear about the things that delight you, we also take to heart the things that we can do better. It’s clear from your feedback many of you are not happy with the previously undisclosed modes being available only on certain higher end PCs. You are most important to us, and we hear your comments. We are unlocking these modes immediately to all players, and we hope you enjoy them. 



We have recommended and still recommend using the Core i7 in order to maintain a constant 90FPS with advanced physics. We also realize that these chips cost money. We created bonus content that was not advertised as a reward for those of you who took us up on our recommendation. 



We wanted you to feel it was worth it, but we also wanted everybody to be able to play these modes eventually. These surprise game modes were meant to be a reward for those players with high-end VR systems who were looking for the most immersive experience possible. 



You are most important to us, and we hear and appreciate your comments. We are unlocking these modes to all players immediately via an automatic update, and we hope you enjoy them. Original story:Arizona Sunshine is a newly released VR FPS set in a post-apocalyptic desert landscape riddled with zombies. It's currently sitting on a "Mostly Positive" rating on Steam, and based on a cursory glance at the community forums, the game has a decent enough following. But not all is well in this particular zombie apocalypse: some users are annoyed that two of the game's modes are exclusive to PCs running 5th, 6th and 7th generation Intel Core i7 CPUs. Both singleplayer Horde mode and the ultra-difficult Apocalyptic Mode are exclusive to i7 CPU owners until March 6 next year.To the best of my knowledge – and to the best of several other PC Gamer scribes' knowledge – a game has never had content exclusivity based on hardware components before. The likes of Nvidia HairWorks improves cosmetic aspects, such as in The Witcher 3, but that's a far cry from locking off playable in-game content to incentivise purchasing a high-end CPU.The thing is, it appears that no word was given in advance that this exclusivity existed, though there's plenty of videos promoting the benefits of an i7 when playing the game, such as this trailer and this behind-the-scenes dev video. Responding to a concerned user in the game's Steam forums, a Vertigo Games spokeperson explained the situation. "These are two game modes that we have not focused on previously," the statement said. "Working with Intel allowed us to create even more content than we originally planned, including these modes and the physics systems in the game, making Arizona Sunshine one of the richest VR experiences possible. "We want to give 5th, 6th and 7th gen Intel Core i7 owners first glimpse into these additional modes, but they’ll be available March 6, 2017 to everyone who owns the game."It's an unprecedented move, which might have been more acceptable had prospective purchasers of the game known about it. I've sent an Intel rep an email, and will update the story if I hear back.

notes.title: Release Date, Pre-order, & Closed Beta Update
notes.content:
It's finally here!

We have a release date, and you can pre-order now!

Arizona Sunshine releases on December 6, 2016 for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift with Touch support.

Priced at $39.99, the game is now available for pre-order at a 15% discount. Pre-orders will also receive an Arizona Sunshine compositor image for their headsets, a desktop background image, and concept art from the game. 

Can't wait for December? The closed beta is November 22-29. The cut-off to sign-up is November 15th, so we will notify the participants shortly after that. Sign up  here .

Still want more? Check this out.  Playing One of VR’s Most Violent and Exciting Games by Ben Kuchera.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/c30deecd15e6e0450c3cced5f41429984ecd3ae7.jpg
 
i5 vs i7 CPU 

So what's the big deal here? You keep telling us about the i7 or equivalent processor and what it does, but what do I get with it? Why do I want it?

Well, believe it or not, when you have to run a game at 90FPS, you become GPU limited quickly. Using Unity, you also do not have PhysX acceleration on the GPU, so the best option for advanced physics is to use a multi-threaded and multi-core CPU. Because of the advanced physics involved to make the game feel as immersive and realistic as possible, we recommend gamers use a CPU like the Intel® Core™ i7 processor. 

The game plays normally with an i5 or equivalent, but if your CPU has the speed, cores, and threads, you can turn on the advanced physics. While you can technically try advanced physics without the latest, fastest CPU, we don't recommend it. The CPU would choke. We've tested it.

What's the big deal? Check it out here.

https://youtu.be/ic3EKqa8270

notes.title: The Refinery & Closed Beta Update
notes.content:
As announced in last week's newsletter (sign up @ www.arizona-sunshine.com ), the closed beta will consist of the first four levels of the game, ending at the conclusion of the Ol' Dutchman Mine. It will start in November, and we will announce the specific dates in the near future along with the cutoff date for signing up.

Participants will be randomly selected from the newsletter subscriber list and must own an HTC Vive or have access to Oculus Touch to participate. You must also:

- Sign up with a valid email address
- Be 18 years of age
- Accept the invitation and terms of service within three days of being selected
- Have a Steam or an Oculus Home account

We have previously shared some details about the levels that will be included in the beta, but we don't want to end this post without sharing some info about a new level - The Refinery.
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/447d6a0f7261abd42f6cd12a7ae5faaa42c42c35.jpg

As you start the level, you notice something new. Signs of civilization.
 
All you have to do is get past a horde of zombies and that enormous wall. You just can't catch a break.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8824504/c30deecd15e6e0450c3cced5f41429984ecd3ae7.jpg

This place looks like a fortress. Someone gets an A+ in zombie survival planning. It'd be nice if they're still around. All this zombie killing is tiring. Somebody else needs to start carrying some weight around here.
 
This is going to suck if nobody else is here to help. There are buildings, towers, storage tanks and pipes everywhere to search. 

Better get a move on. Standing around won't get you any closer to safety.
